description: 迷彩獵手（stalker）的建置配方：build_character.py 依這份檔案從頭產出角色。每個步驟的輸入輸出見 design/03-art-pipeline/CHARACTER_PIPELINE.md。
name: 迷彩獵手

design.prompt: Anime cel-shaded character art in the style of Studio Trigger's Cyberpunk Edgerunners: flat colors, bold clean black outlines, hard-edged two-tone shading, saturated neon accents. Full body, strict side view facing right, standing upright with the arms relaxed at the sides and empty hands, the far-side leg hidden behind the near leg. a stalker, tall and slim, about seven and a half heads tall: a skin-tight optical-camouflage suit in muted grey-teal with a faint shimmer, a cloak-like translucent tail of cloth at the hips, a smooth hood with a single glowing magenta eye lens, light shoulder pauldron and knee pads, dark boots and gloves.
